mapper.select: select from app_source_repository_slots where repository_id = #{repositoryId}
select from app_source_repository_slots where repository_id = #{repositoryId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_repository_slots() values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.activeGeneration}, #{row.pendingGeneration}, #{row.nextGeneration}, #{row.latestOperationId}, #{row.lockVersion}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict (repository_id) do nothing

merge into app_source_repository_slots target using (values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.activeGeneration}, #{row.pendingGeneration}, #{row.nextGeneration}, #{row.latestOperationId}, #{row.lockVersion}, cast(#{row.createdAt} as timestamp), cast(#{row.updatedAt} as timestamp) )) source(repository_id, active_generation, pending_generation, next_generation, latest_operation_id, lock_version, created_at, updated_at) on target.repository_id = source.repository_id when not matched then insert () values ( source.repository_id, source.active_generation, source.pending_generation, source.next_generation, source.latest_operation_id, source.lock_version, source.created_at, source.updated_at)
mapper.select: select from app_source_snapshots where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and generation = #{generation}
select from app_source_snapshots where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_snapshots() values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.repositoryEnglishName}, #{row.purpose}, #{row.ownerUserId}, #{row.branch}, #{row.targetCommit}, cast(#{row.selectedPathsJson} as jsonb), #{row.indexSha256}, #{row.acceptedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})

insert into app_source_snapshots() values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.repositoryEnglishName}, #{row.purpose}, #{row.ownerUserId}, #{row.branch}, #{row.targetCommit}, cast(#{row.selectedPathsJson} as json), #{row.indexSha256}, #{row.acceptedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.update: update app_source_snapshots set status = #{nextStatus}, index_sha256 = #{indexSha256}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and generation = #{generation} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: select from app_source_replicas where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and generation = #{generation} and linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId}
select from app_source_replicas where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and generation = #{generation} order by linux_server_id

select from app_source_replicas replica where replica.linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId} and ( replica.status = 'PENDING' or (replica.status = 'RUNNING' and replica.lease_until <= #{now}) or (replica.status in ('FAILED', 'STALE') and exists ( select 1 from app_source_operations operation join app_source_operation_steps step on step.operation_id = operation.operation_id where operation.repository_id = replica.repository_id and operation.target_generation = replica.generation and operation.operation_type = 'RETRY_REPLICAS' and operation.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and step.scope = 'SERVER' and step.linux_server_id = replica.linux_server_id and step.step_code in ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_QUEUED') and step.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') )) ) order by replica.updated_at, replica.repository_id, replica.generation limit #{limit}
select from app_source_replicas where runtime_workspace_id = #{runtimeWorkspaceId}
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_replicas() values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.linuxServerId}, #{row.runtimeWorkspaceId}, #{row.status}, #{row.leaseOwner}, #{row.leaseUntil}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextRetryAt}, #{row.safeErrorCode}, #{row.safeErrorMessage}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict (repository_id, generation, linux_server_id) do nothing

merge into app_source_replicas target using (values ( #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.linuxServerId}, #{row.runtimeWorkspaceId}, #{row.status}, #{row.leaseOwner}, cast(#{row.leaseUntil} as timestamp), #{row.attemptCount}, cast(#{row.nextRetryAt} as timestamp), #{row.safeErrorCode}, #{row.safeErrorMessage}, cast(#{row.createdAt} as timestamp), cast(#{row.updatedAt} as timestamp) )) source(repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, runtime_workspace_id, status, lease_owner, lease_until, attempt_count, next_retry_at, safe_error_code, safe_error_message, created_at, updated_at) on target.repository_id = source.repository_id and target.generation = source.generation and target.linux_server_id = source.linux_server_id when not matched then insert () values ( source.repository_id, source.generation, source.linux_server_id, source.runtime_workspace_id, source.status, source.lease_owner, source.lease_until, source.attempt_count, source.next_retry_at, source.safe_error_code, source.safe_error_message, source.created_at, source.updated_at)
mapper.select: select from app_source_operations where operation_id = #{operationId}
select from app_source_operations where repository_id = #{repositoryId} order by accepted_at desc, operation_id desc limit 1

select from app_source_operations operation where operation.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and (operation.status = 'RUNNING' or not exists ( select 1 from app_source_operation_steps step where step.operation_id = operation.operation_id and step.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') )) and exists ( select 1 from app_source_replicas replica where replica.repository_id = operation.repository_id and replica.generation = operation.target_generation ) and not exists ( select 1 from app_source_replicas replica where replica.repository_id = operation.repository_id and replica.generation = operation.target_generation and replica.status not in ('READY', 'FAILED') ) order by operation.accepted_at, operation.operation_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update app_source_operations set status = #{nextStatus}, completed_at = #{completedAt} where operation_id = #{operationId} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_operation_steps() values ( #{row.stepId}, #{row.operationId}, #{row.scope}, #{row.linuxServerId}, #{row.stepCode}, #{row.sequence}, #{row.status}, #{row.safeSummary}, #{row.startedAt}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict (step_id) do update set status = excluded.status, safe_summary = excluded.safe_summary, started_at = excluded.started_at, completed_at = excluded.completed_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at where (app_source_operation_steps.status = 'PENDING' and excluded.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')) or (app_source_operation_steps.status = 'RUNNING' and excluded.status in ('RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED'))

merge into app_source_operation_steps target using (values ( #{row.stepId}, #{row.operationId}, #{row.scope}, #{row.linuxServerId}, #{row.stepCode}, #{row.sequence}, #{row.status}, #{row.safeSummary}, cast(#{row.startedAt} as timestamp), cast(#{row.completedAt} as timestamp), cast(#{row.updatedAt} as timestamp) )) source(step_id, operation_id, scope, linux_server_id, step_code, sequence, status, safe_summary, started_at, completed_at, updated_at) on target.step_id = source.step_id when matched and ( (target.status = 'PENDING' and source.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')) or (target.status = 'RUNNING' and source.status in ('RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')) ) then update set status = source.status, safe_summary = source.safe_summary, started_at = source.started_at, completed_at = source.completed_at, updated_at = source.updated_at when not matched then insert () values ( source.step_id, source.operation_id, source.scope, source.linux_server_id, source.step_code, source.sequence, source.status, source.safe_summary, source.started_at, source.completed_at, source.updated_at)

merge into app_source_operation_steps target using ( select cast(#{row.stepId} as varchar(128)) step_id, cast(#{row.operationId} as varchar(128)) operation_id, cast(#{row.scope} as varchar(16)) scope, cast(#{row.linuxServerId} as varchar(128)) linux_server_id, cast(#{row.stepCode} as varchar(64)) step_code, cast(#{row.sequence} as integer) sequence, cast('PENDING' as varchar(32)) status, cast(#{row.safeSummary} as varchar(1000)) safe_summary, cast(null as timestamp) started_at, cast(null as timestamp) completed_at, cast(#{row.updatedAt} as timestamp) updated_at from app_source_operations operation join app_source_replicas replica on replica.repository_id = operation.repository_id and replica.generation = operation.target_generation and replica.linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId} where operation.operation_id = #{row.operationId} and operation.repository_id = #{repositoryId} and operation.target_generation = #{generation} and operation.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and replica.status = 'RUNNING' and replica.lease_owner = #{expectedLeaseOwner} and replica.lease_until > #{now} ) source on target.step_id = source.step_id when matched then update set status = source.status, safe_summary = source.safe_summary, started_at = source.started_at, completed_at = source.completed_at, updated_at = source.updated_at when not matched then insert () values ( source.step_id, source.operation_id, source.scope, source.linux_server_id, source.step_code, source.sequence, source.status, source.safe_summary, source.started_at, source.completed_at, source.updated_at)
mapper.select: select from app_source_operation_steps where operation_id = #{operationId} order by sequence, step_id
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_cleanup_tasks() values ( #{row.cleanupTaskId}, #{row.operationId}, #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.linuxServerId}, #{row.deleteAt}, #{row.status}, #{row.leaseOwner}, #{row.leaseUntil}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextRetryAt}, #{row.safeErrorCode}, #{row.safeErrorMessage}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict (repository_id, generation, linux_server_id) do nothing

merge into app_source_cleanup_tasks target using (values ( #{row.cleanupTaskId}, #{row.operationId}, #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.linuxServerId}, cast(#{row.deleteAt} as timestamp), #{row.status}, #{row.leaseOwner}, cast(#{row.leaseUntil} as timestamp), #{row.attemptCount}, cast(#{row.nextRetryAt} as timestamp), #{row.safeErrorCode}, #{row.safeErrorMessage}, #{row.traceId}, cast(#{row.createdAt} as timestamp), cast(#{row.updatedAt} as timestamp) )) source(cleanup_task_id, operation_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, delete_at, status, lease_owner, lease_until, attempt_count, next_retry_at, safe_error_code, safe_error_message, trace_id, created_at, updated_at) on target.repository_id = source.repository_id and target.generation = source.generation and target.linux_server_id = source.linux_server_id when not matched then insert () values ( source.cleanup_task_id, source.operation_id, source.repository_id, source.generation, source.linux_server_id, source.delete_at, source.status, source.lease_owner, source.lease_until, source.attempt_count, source.next_retry_at, source.safe_error_code, source.safe_error_message, source.trace_id, source.created_at, source.updated_at)
mapper.select: select from app_source_cleanup_tasks where cleanup_task_id = #{cleanupTaskId}
select user_id, app_id, repository_id, generation, updated_at from app_source_recent_selections where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into app_source_recent_selections(user_id, app_id, repository_id, generation, updated_at) values (#{row.userId}, #{row.appId}, #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.generation}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict (user_id) do update set app_id = excluded.app_id, repository_id = excluded.repository_id, generation = excluded.generation, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
